tests.title: static original and bounded optimized variants work without remote image access
cards select responsive resources and detail credits the source-owned illustration
unavailable artwork keeps layout and navigation with and without JavaScript
real local session creates/selects a profile with keyboard focus and private cache reset
Router accepts exact Web preflight but rejects forged origin and fetch metadata
profile outage exposes retry and keeps public browsing available
expiry removes private controls without a refetch loop and reduced-motion dialog traps focus
served HTML and browser-loaded public/lazy assets contain no private server artifacts
published public HTML hydrates without browser GraphQL or automatic route prefetch
Portuguese public browsing and title attribution work with JavaScript disabled
delayed scripts do not hide public content or create hydration mismatches
keyboard-only skip, title navigation and attribution navigation
Router outage renders useful SSR without JavaScript and explicit retry recovers
refresh announces stale data only while pending, rejects partial errors, and retries once
explicit refresh follows the current consumer after shared-query route changes
empty, missing and invalid inputs differ from unavailable data; home locale is respected
